aiHub.name: Jungle Scurry
aiHub.tagline: A little trouble. A grand adventure.
aiHub.description: Swing across the canopy, dive past crocodiles, dodge a rumbling hillside and ring three Sunbells to rescue Professor Pip. A lush ink-and-cel arcade expedition for one or two scouts.
aiHub.controls: WASD/arrows or left stick to move; Space/Cross to jump or release; E/Square to use tool or ring; S/Circle to duck; Esc/Options to pause. Touch drag and contextual tap.
